modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate = class({})

local RATE_SCALE = 1000

local function IsMoveOrder(order_type)
    return order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_POSITION
        or order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET
        or order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_MOVE
        or order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_DIRECTION
        or order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PATROL
end

local function IsSameUnit(parent, unit)
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if unit == parent then
        return true
    end
    return type(unit) == "number" and parent.entindex and unit == parent:entindex()
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsHidden()
    return true
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsPurgable()
    return false
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsDebuff()
    return false
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE,
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ORDER,
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_UNIT_MOVED,
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ATTACK_START,
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ABILITY_START,
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_STATE_CHANGED,
    }
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnCreated(keys)
    self.base_anim_speed = 300
    self.move_intent = false
    self.debug = keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 or false

    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end

    if IsServer() then
        self:SetStackCount(0)
    end

    if self.debug then
        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] create unit=%s base_anim_speed=%.1f",
            tostring(self:GetParent()), self.base_anim_speed))
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnRefresh(keys)
    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end
    if keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 then
        self.debug = true
    end
    if self.debug then
        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] refresh unit=%s base_anim_speed=%.1f",
            tostring(self:GetParent()), self.base_anim_speed))
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:SyncRate(rate)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end

    local stack = 0
    if rate and rate > 0 then
        stack = math.floor(rate * RATE_SCALE + 0.5)
    end

    if self:GetStackCount() ~= stack then
        self:SetStackCount(stack)
        self:ForceRefresh()
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:ComputeRate()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return nil, "parent_invalid"
    end
    if not self.move_intent then
        return nil, "no_move_intent"
    end
    if parent:IsStunned() or parent:IsHexed() or parent:IsRooted() then
        return nil, "cc_blocked"
    end
    if parent.IsAttacking and parent:IsAttacking() then
        return nil, "attacking"
    end
    if parent.IsChanneling and parent:IsChanneling() then
        return nil, "channeling"
    end
    if parent.IsMoving and not parent:IsMoving() then
        return nil, "not_moving"
    end

    local speed = parent:GetIdealSpeed()
    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
        speed = parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
    end

    local rate = speed / self.base_anim_speed
    if rate < 0.2 then
        rate = 0.2
    elseif rate > 3.0 then
        rate = 3.0
    end
    return rate, nil
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:RefreshSyncedRate(reason)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end

    local rate, skip = self:ComputeRate()
    self:SyncRate(rate)

    if self.debug then
        local parent = self:GetParent()
        local eid = parent and not parent:IsNull() and parent:entindex() or -1
        if rate then
            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync_rate unit=%d reason=%s rate=%.3f stack=%d",
                eid, tostring(reason), rate, self:GetStackCount()))
        else
            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync_rate unit=%d reason=%s skip=%s stack=%d",
                eid, tostring(reason), tostring(skip), self:GetStackCount()))
        end
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnOrder(keys)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not IsSameUnit(parent, keys and keys.unit) then
        return
    end

    self.move_intent = IsMoveOrder(keys.order_type)
    self:RefreshSyncedRate("order_" .. tostring(keys.order_type))
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnUnitMoved(keys)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not IsSameUnit(parent, keys and keys.unit) then
        return
    end
    self:RefreshSyncedRate("unit_moved")
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnAttackStart(keys)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() or keys.attacker ~= parent then
        return
    end
    self.move_intent = false
    self:RefreshSyncedRate("attack_start")
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnAbilityStart(keys)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not IsSameUnit(parent, keys and keys.unit) then
        return
    end
    self.move_intent = false
    self:RefreshSyncedRate("ability_start")
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnStateChanged(keys)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not IsSameUnit(parent, keys and keys.unit) then
        return
    end
    self:RefreshSyncedRate("state_changed")
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetOverrideAnimation()
    local stack = self:GetStackCount()
    if stack <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return ACT_DOTA_RUN
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetOverrideAnimationRate()
    local now = (GameRules and GameRules.GetGameTime and GameRules:GetGameTime()) or 0
    local can_log_client = IsClient() and self.debug and (not self._last_client_log_t or now - self._last_client_log_t >= 0.2)
    local stack = self:GetStackCount()
    if stack <= 0 then
        if can_log_client then
            print("[unitanim_mod_client] rate=nil stack=0")
            self._last_client_log_t = now
        end
        return nil
    end

    local rate = stack / RATE_SCALE
    if can_log_client then
        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod_client] rate=%.3f stack=%d", rate, stack))
        self._last_client_log_t = now
    end
    return rate
end

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate.lua
+modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate = class({})
+
+local RATE_SCALE = 1000
+
+local function IsMoveOrder(order_type)
+    return order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_POSITION
+        or order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET
+        or order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_MOVE
+        or order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_DIRECTION
+        or order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PATROL
+end
+
+local function IsSameUnit(parent, unit)
+    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
+        return false
+    end
+    if unit == parent then
+        return true
+    end
+    return type(unit) == "number" and parent.entindex and unit == parent:entindex()
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsHidden()
+    return true
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsPurgable()
+    return false
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsDebuff()
+    return false
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:DeclareFunctions()
+    return {
+        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE,
+        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ORDER,
+        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_UNIT_MOVED,
+        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ATTACK_START,
+        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ABILITY_START,
+        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_STATE_CHANGED,
+    }
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnCreated(keys)
+    self.base_anim_speed = 300
+    self.move_intent = false
+    self.debug = keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 or false
+
+    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
+        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
+        if v and v > 0 then
+            self.base_anim_speed = v
+        end
+    end
+
+    if IsServer() then
+        self:SetStackCount(0)
+    end
+
+    if self.debug then
+        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] create unit=%s base_anim_speed=%.1f",
+            tostring(self:GetParent()), self.base_anim_speed))
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnRefresh(keys)
+    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
+        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
+        if v and v > 0 then
+            self.base_anim_speed = v
+        end
+    end
+    if keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 then
+        self.debug = true
+    end
+    if self.debug then
+        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] refresh unit=%s base_anim_speed=%.1f",
+            tostring(self:GetParent()), self.base_anim_speed))
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:SyncRate(rate)
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+
+    local stack = 0
+    if rate and rate > 0 then
+        stack = math.floor(rate * RATE_SCALE + 0.5)
+    end
+
+    if self:GetStackCount() ~= stack then
+        self:SetStackCount(stack)
+        self:ForceRefresh()
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:ComputeRate()
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
+        return nil, "parent_invalid"
+    end
+    if not self.move_intent then
+        return nil, "no_move_intent"
+    end
+    if parent:IsStunned() or parent:IsHexed() or parent:IsRooted() then
+        return nil, "cc_blocked"
+    end
+    if parent.IsAttacking and parent:IsAttacking() then
+        return nil, "attacking"
+    end
+    if parent.IsChanneling and parent:IsChanneling() then
+        return nil, "channeling"
+    end
+    if parent.IsMoving and not parent:IsMoving() then
+        return nil, "not_moving"
+    end
+
+    local speed = parent:GetIdealSpeed()
+    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
+        speed = parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
+    end
+
+    local rate = speed / self.base_anim_speed
+    if rate < 0.2 then
+        rate = 0.2
+    elseif rate > 3.0 then
+        rate = 3.0
+    end
+    return rate, nil
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:RefreshSyncedRate(reason)
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+
+    local rate, skip = self:ComputeRate()
+    self:SyncRate(rate)
+
+    if self.debug then
+        local parent = self:GetParent()
+        local eid = parent and not parent:IsNull() and parent:entindex() or -1
+        if rate then
+            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync_rate unit=%d reason=%s rate=%.3f stack=%d",
+                eid, tostring(reason), rate, self:GetStackCount()))
+        else
+            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync_rate unit=%d reason=%s skip=%s stack=%d",
+                eid, tostring(reason), tostring(skip), self:GetStackCount()))
+        end
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnOrder(keys)
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not IsSameUnit(parent, keys and keys.unit) then
+        return
+    end
+
+    self.move_intent = IsMoveOrder(keys.order_type)
+    self:RefreshSyncedRate("order_" .. tostring(keys.order_type))
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnUnitMoved(keys)
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not IsSameUnit(parent, keys and keys.unit) then
+        return
+    end
+    self:RefreshSyncedRate("unit_moved")
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnAttackStart(keys)
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not parent or parent:IsNull() or keys.attacker ~= parent then
+        return
+    end
+    self.move_intent = false
+    self:RefreshSyncedRate("attack_start")
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnAbilityStart(keys)
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not IsSameUnit(parent, keys and keys.unit) then
+        return
+    end
+    self.move_intent = false
+    self:RefreshSyncedRate("ability_start")
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnStateChanged(keys)
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not IsSameUnit(parent, keys and keys.unit) then
+        return
+    end
+    self:RefreshSyncedRate("state_changed")
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetOverrideAnimationRate()
+    local now = (GameRules and GameRules.GetGameTime and GameRules:GetGameTime()) or 0
+    local can_log_client = IsClient() and self.debug and (not self._last_client_log_t or now - self._last_client_log_t >= 0.2)
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
+        return nil
+    end
+
+    local activity = nil
+    if parent.GetCurrentActiveActivity then
+        activity = parent:GetCurrentActiveActivity()
+    elseif parent.GetActivity then
+        activity = parent:GetActivity()
+    end
+
+    if activity ~= nil and activity ~= ACT_DOTA_RUN then
+        if can_log_client then
+            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod_client] rate=nil not_run activity=%s", tostring(activity)))
+            self._last_client_log_t = now
+        end
+        return nil
+    end
+
+    local stack = self:GetStackCount()
+    if stack <= 0 then
+        if can_log_client then
+            print("[unitanim_mod_client] rate=nil stack=0")
+            self._last_client_log_t = now
+        end
+        return nil
+    end
+
+    local rate = stack / RATE_SCALE
+    if can_log_client then
+        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod_client] rate=%.3f stack=%d", rate, stack))
+        self._last_client_log_t = now
+    end
+    return rate
+end
*** End Patch

- `MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ATTACK_START`：攻击开始时关闭移动速率覆盖
- `MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ABILITY_START`：施法开始时关闭覆盖
- `MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_STATE_CHANGED`：被控/状态变化时刷新或关闭

如果删掉这些事件，服务端就没有时机更新 `stack_count`，客户端会读到旧值或一直是 0。

是“只在 `ACT_DOTA_RUN` 时返回 rate”，但这不等于“不要服务端事件”。

两层逻辑现在是：

1. 客户端返回层  
`GetOverrideAnimationRate()` 里确实只在 run activity 下返回速率，否则 `nil`。

2. 服务端计算层  
这些事件仍需要，用来决定何时计算/同步 `stack_count`（速率值）。  
没有事件，`stack` 不更新，run 时也拿不到正确新值。

所以两者不冲突：  
- `ACT_DOTA_RUN` 是最终生效门槛  
- 事件是速率数据更新机制。

是“只在 `ACT_DOTA_RUN` 时返回 rate”，但这不等于“不要服务端事件”。

两层逻辑现在是：

1. 客户端返回层  
`GetOverrideAnimationRate()` 里确实只在 run activity 下返回速率，否则 `nil`。

2. 服务端计算层  
这些事件仍需要，用来决定何时计算/同步 `stack_count`（速率值）。  
没有事件，`stack` 不更新，run 时也拿不到正确新值。

所以两者不冲突：  
- `ACT_DOTA_RUN` 是最终生效门槛

    return true

    self.base_anim_speed = 300
    self.debug = keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 or false
    self.last_speed = nil

    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end

    if IsServer() then
        self:SetStackCount(0)
        self:StartIntervalThink(0.1)
    end

    if self.debug then
        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] create unit=%s base_anim_speed=%.1f",

    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnRefresh(keys)
    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end
    if keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 then
        self.debug = true
    end
    if self.debug then
        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] refresh unit=%s base_anim_speed=%.1f",
            tostring(self:GetParent()), self.base_anim_speed))
    end
    if IsServer() then
        self.last_speed = nil
        self:UpdateSyncedRate("refresh")
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:SyncRate(rate, reason)
    local stack = 0
    if rate and rate > 0 then
        stack = math.floor(rate * RATE_SCALE + 0.5)
    end

    if self:GetStackCount() ~= stack then
        self:SetStackCount(stack)
        self:ForceRefresh()
        if self.debug then
            local parent = self:GetParent()
            local eid = parent and not parent:IsNull() and parent:entindex() or -1
            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync_rate unit=%d reason=%s rate=%s stack=%d",
                eid, tostring(reason), tostring(rate), stack))
        end
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:ComputeRateBySpeed(speed)
    local s = tonumber(speed) or 0
    if s <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local rate = s / self.base_anim_speed
    if rate < 0.2 then
        rate = 0.2
    elseif rate > 3.0 then
        rate = 3.0
    end
    return rate
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    local speed = parent:GetIdealSpeed()
    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
        speed = parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
    end
    return speed
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:UpdateSyncedRate(reason)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end
    local speed = self:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    local rate = self:ComputeRateBySpeed(speed)
    self:SyncRate(rate, reason)
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnIntervalThink()
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end
    local speed = self:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    if not speed then
        return
    end
    if not self.last_speed or math.abs(speed - self.last_speed) > 0.1 then
        self.last_speed = speed
        self:UpdateSyncedRate("speed_changed")
        if self.debug then
            local parent = self:GetParent()
            local eid = parent and not parent:IsNull() and parent:entindex() or -1
            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] speed_changed unit=%d speed=%.1f", eid, speed))
        end
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetOverrideAnimationRate()
    local now = (GameRules and GameRules.GetGameTime and GameRules:GetGameTime()) or 0
    local can_log_client = IsClient() and self.debug and (not self._last_client_log_t or now - self._last_client_log_t >= 0.2)
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    local activity = nil
    if parent.GetCurrentActiveActivity then
        activity = parent:GetCurrentActiveActivity()
    elseif parent.GetActivity then
        activity = parent:GetActivity()
    end

    if activity ~= nil and activity ~= ACT_DOTA_RUN then
        if can_log_client then
            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod_client] rate=nil not_run activity=%s", tostring(activity)))
            self._last_client_log_t = now
        end
        return nil
    end

    local stack = self:GetStackCount()
    if stack <= 0 then
        if can_log_client then
            print("[unitanim_mod_client] rate=nil stack=0")
            self._last_client_log_t = now
        end
        return nil
    end

    local rate = stack / RATE_SCALE

        print(string.format("[unitanim_mod_client] rate=%.3f stack=%d", rate, stack))
        self._last_client_log_t = now
    end
    return rate
end

结论：**接近最优，但还不是严格意义上的最优**。

按 Dota2 modifier 架构看，你现在这版优点很对：

- `modifier` 不轮询，改为外部改速后主动 `SyncNow`，这点是对的。  
  位置：`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate.lua:110`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/test_mode.lua:251`
- 客户端只在 `GetOverrideAnimationRate` 返回同步值，计算在服务端完成，方向正确。
- 非 run activity 返回 `nil`（尽量不覆盖其他动画速率逻辑），思路正确。

还差的两点（这两点会影响“最优”）：

1. **用 `stack_count` 传 float 是可用但不是最规范**  
- 现在用 `RATE_SCALE` 编码到 stack（`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate.lua:3`）。  
- 更规范是用 `SetHasCustomTransmitterData` 传 `rate`/`enabled`，避免占用 stack 通道。

2. **run activity 判定依赖 API 可用性**  
- 你用了 `GetCurrentActiveActivity`/`GetActivity`（`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate.lua:127`）。  
- 若某端拿不到 activity（`nil`），当前逻辑会继续返回 rate，可能不是“只在 run 下生效”的严格语义。

所以：  
**架构方向是对的，性能上已经很好；要到“最优”，建议把同步从 stack 切到 transmitter data，并把 run 判定改成确定可用的统一门槛。**

你说得对，这轮实现走了弯路。根因是我在中间阶段为了快速可观测调试，先堆了过渡逻辑，没有一次性收敛到最小正确实现。

最小正确实现应当是：

1. 服务端只保留两个状态：`enabled`、`rate`  
2. 外部改移速后只调用一次 `SyncNow()`  
3. 用 modifier transmitter 同步 `enabled/rate` 到客户端  
4. 客户端 `GetOverrideAnimationRate()` 只做：
- 非 run 或 `enabled=false` -> `nil`
- 否则返回 `rate`

这就是你说的“直接最优方案”。  
如果你确认，我下一步就把当前文件重写成这个精简版（删除 stack 编码和多余调试分支），一次到位。

modifier_item_stats = class({})

function modifier_item_stats:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_stats:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_stats:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_stats:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_stats:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ABILITY_SPECIAL,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ABILITY_SPECIAL_VALUE,
    }
end

function modifier_item_stats:GetModifierOverrideAbilitySpecial(params)
    if not self.tooltips then return 0 end

    if params.ability == self:GetAbility()
        and self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value] then
        --print("[Item AbilitySpecial]", self, params.ability_special_value, self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value])
        return 1
    end

    return 0
end

function modifier_item_stats:GetModifierOverrideAbilitySpecialValue(params)
    if not self.tooltips then return 0 end

    if not IsServer() then
        --print("[modifier_item_stats] Client", params.ability_special_value)
    end

    if params.ability == self:GetAbility()
        and self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value] then
        -- print("[Item AbilitySpecialValue]", self, params.ability_special_value,
        --     self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value])
        return self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value]
    end

    return 0
end

function modifier_item_stats:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        self:InitStat()
    end)
end

function modifier_item_stats:InitStat()
    --print("[modifier_item_stats] Server", self)
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local ability = self:GetAbility()
    if not ability then return end

    local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if pid < 0 then return end

    local lvl = ability.custom_level or self.custom_level or 1
    self.level = lvl
    local name = ability.raw_name
    local raw_kv = ItemKV[name] or AbilityKV[name]
    local type = 1
    if raw_kv and raw_kv.Shop then
        type = tonumber(raw_kv.Shop)
    end

    local kv = {}
    if type == 1 then
        kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name] or {}
    elseif type == 2 then
        kv = Shop2ItemsKV[name] or {}
    elseif type == 3 then
        kv = Shop3ItemsKV[name] or {}
    end

    self.kv = kv

    self:CollectValues()
    self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()

    ability:SetLevel(self.level)
    self:ForceRefresh()

    local attrs = {}

    if kv.BonusAttribute then
        for k, v in pairs(kv.BonusAttribute) do
            local value_array = ParseArray(v)
            local attr_value = value_array[lvl]
            if attr_value ~= nil then
                attrs[k] = attr_value
            end
        end
    end

    if next(attrs) ~= nil then
        StatsManager:AddSource(pid, self:GetSourceId(), attrs, {
            type = "equip",
            item = name,
            level = lvl,
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:CollectValues()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    local ab = self:GetAbility()

    local kv = ab:GetAbilityKeyValues()
    local sp = kv.AbilityValues

    if not sp then return end

    self.tooltips = {}
    self.tooltips.BonusAttributeKeys = {}
    for k, v in pairs(sp) do
        if k == "Level" then
            self.tooltips[k] = self.level
        else
            local kv_value = ab:GetSpecialValueFor(k)

            if not self.kv.BonusAttribute then
                return
            end

            local array = self.kv[k] or self.kv.BonusAttribute[k]

            if self.kv.BonusAttribute[k] then
                table.insert(self.tooltips.BonusAttributeKeys, k)
            end

            local value = 0
            if array then
                value = ParseArray(array)[self.level] or 0
            end
            self.tooltips[k] = value

            --print("[modifier_item_stats] tooltip", k, value, self.level)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()

    if pid >= 0 then
        StatsManager:RemoveSource(pid, self:GetSourceId())
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:GetSourceId()
    if self:GetAbility() == nil then
        return
    end

    return "equip_" .. self:GetAbility():GetAbilityName() .. "_" .. tostring(self)
end

function modifier_item_stats:AddCustomTransmitterData()
    return {
        tooltips = self.tooltips or {}
    }
end

function modifier_item_stats:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
    --print("[modifier_item_stats] Client", self)
    self.tooltips = data.tooltips or {}

    --DeepPrintTable(self.tooltips)
end

+modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate = class({})
+
+local function Clamp(v, lo, hi)
+    if v < lo then
+        return lo
+    end
+    if v > hi then
+        return hi
+    end
+    return v
+end
+
+local function GetRunActivity(unit)
+    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
+        return nil
+    end
+    if unit.GetCurrentActiveActivity then
+        return unit:GetCurrentActiveActivity()
+    end
+    if unit.GetActivity then
+        return unit:GetActivity()
+    end
+    return nil
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsHidden()
+    return true
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsPurgable()
+    return false
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsDebuff()
+    return false
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:DeclareFunctions()
+    return {
+        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE,
+    }
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnCreated(keys)
+    self.base_anim_speed = 300
+    self.synced_rate = 1
+    self.debug = keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 or false
+
+    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
+        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
+        if v and v > 0 then
+            self.base_anim_speed = v
+        end
+    end
+
+    if IsServer() then
+        self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
+        self:SyncNow("created")
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnRefresh(keys)
+    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
+        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
+        if v and v > 0 then
+            self.base_anim_speed = v
+        end
+    end
+    if keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 then
+        self.debug = true
+    end
+
+    if IsServer() then
+        self:SyncNow("refresh")
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local speed = parent:GetIdealSpeed()
+    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
+        speed = parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
+    end
+    return speed
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:ComputeRate()
+    local speed = self:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
+    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
+        return 1
+    end
+    return Clamp(speed / self.base_anim_speed, 0.2, 3.0)
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:SyncNow(reason)
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+
+    local new_rate = self:ComputeRate()
+    if math.abs((self.synced_rate or 0) - new_rate) > 0.0001 then
+        self.synced_rate = new_rate
+        self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
+        if self.debug then
+            local parent = self:GetParent()
+            local eid = parent and not parent:IsNull() and parent:entindex() or -1
+            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync unit=%d reason=%s rate=%.3f",
+                eid, tostring(reason), new_rate))
+        end
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:AddCustomTransmitterData()
+    return {
+        rate = self.synced_rate or 1,
+    }
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
+    self.synced_rate = tonumber(data.rate) or 1
+end
+
+function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetOverrideAnimationRate()
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    local activity = GetRunActivity(parent)
+    if activity ~= ACT_DOTA_RUN then
+        return nil
+    end
+    return self.synced_rate
+end
*** End Patch

modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate = class({})

local function Clamp(v, lo, hi)
    if v < lo then
        return lo
    end
    if v > hi then
        return hi
    end
    return v
end

local function GetRunActivity(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if unit.GetCurrentActiveActivity then
        return unit:GetCurrentActiveActivity()
    end
    if unit.GetActivity then
        return unit:GetActivity()
    end
    return nil
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsHidden()
    return true
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsPurgable()
    return false
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsDebuff()
    return false
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE,
    }
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnCreated(keys)
    self.base_anim_speed = 300
    self.synced_rate = 1
    self.debug = keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 or false

    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end

    if IsServer() then
        self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
        self:SyncNow("created")
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnRefresh(keys)
    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end
    if keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 then
        self.debug = true
    end

    if IsServer() then
        self:SyncNow("refresh")
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local speed = parent:GetIdealSpeed()
    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
        speed = parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
    end
    return speed
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:ComputeRate()
    local speed = self:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
        return 1
    end
    return Clamp(speed / self.base_anim_speed, 0.2, 3.0)
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:SyncNow(reason)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end

    local new_rate = self:ComputeRate()
    if math.abs((self.synced_rate or 0) - new_rate) > 0.0001 then
        self.synced_rate = new_rate
        self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
        if self.debug then
            local parent = self:GetParent()
            local eid = parent and not parent:IsNull() and parent:entindex() or -1
            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync unit=%d reason=%s rate=%.3f",
                eid, tostring(reason), new_rate))
        end
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:AddCustomTransmitterData()
    return {
        rate = self.synced_rate or 1,
    }
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
    self.synced_rate = tonumber(data.rate) or 1
    print("[Anim Rate Sync]", self.synced_rate)
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetOverrideAnimationRate()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local activity = GetRunActivity(parent)

    print("[Anim Rate]", activity)

    if activity ~= ACT_DOTA_RUN then
        return nil
    end

    print("[Anim Rate]", self.synced_rate)
    return self.synced_rate
end

# Dota2 Ability

## Overview

Create or rewrite Dota 2 abilities using KV + Lua, using proven patterns for modifiers, events, projectiles, and API-driven behavior.

## Workflow

1) Decide the change type
- Pure data change: edit KV only.
- Behavior change: add or modify Lua.
- Awakening override: add awakening modifier + KV entry.

2) Update KV
- Locate the hero KV in `scripts/npc/heros_ability/`.
- Add or edit the ability block and `AbilityValues`.
- Keep value formats consistent with the existing file.

3) Update Lua
- Place ability scripts in `scripts/vscripts/hero/hero_<name>/`.
- Add modifiers and link with `LinkLuaModifier`.
- Use `GetIntrinsicModifierName` for passives.
- Use `OnAbilityFullyCast` for extra casts or multi-target logic.

4) Apply project-specific extensions (optional)
- If the project uses an awaken-style system, follow its override and registry rules.
- Otherwise keep changes within KV + Lua and the standard ability/modifier flow.

## Guidance

- Prefer KV edits for numbers; use Lua for behavior changes.
- Avoid hardcoding numbers in Lua if the KV can express them.
- Gate difficulty scaling with `GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty()`.
- Use `Timers:CreateTimer` for sequenced effects; avoid global state.
- Keep logic server-side; guard with `if not IsServer() then return end`.
- For projectiles where tracking particles do not move with linear projectiles, use a tracking dummy + tracking projectile for visuals and a linear projectile for damage; destroy the visual projectile on hit/expire via `visual_proj_id` in `ExtraData`.
- Treat the built-in modifier list as valid engine-provided names; do not re-define them in Lua.

## Task Mapping

- "Adjust numbers by difficulty" -> KV scaling or project-specific override logic.
- "Make ability passive" -> `GetIntrinsicModifierName` + intrinsic modifier logic.
- "Add extra casts/targets" -> `OnAbilityFullyCast` + dummy caster or manual calls.
- "Rewrite projectile behavior" -> create projectiles and handle `OnProjectileHit`.
- "Add new ability" -> KV block + new Lua ability file + LinkLuaModifier.

## References

- Dota 2 ability overview: `references/dota2-ability-overview.md`
- Ability KV format: `references/ability-kv-format.md`
- Lua patterns and hooks: `references/lua-ability-patterns.md`
- Awaken examples (project-specific): `references/awaken-ability-examples.md`
- Built-in modifier names (authoritative list): `references/built-in-modifier-names.md`

## Assets

- Ability templates (KV + Lua + optional awakening modifier): `assets/ability-template/`

modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate = class({})

local function Clamp(v, lo, hi)
    if v < lo then
        return lo
    end
    if v > hi then
        return hi
    end
    return v
end

local function GetRunActivity(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if unit.GetCurrentActiveActivity then
        return unit:GetCurrentActiveActivity()
    end
    if unit.GetActivity then
        return unit:GetActivity()
    end
    return nil
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsHidden()
    return true
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsPurgable()
    return false
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsDebuff()
    return false
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE,
    }
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnCreated(keys)
    self.base_anim_speed = 300
    self.synced_rate = 1
    self.debug = keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 or false

    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end

    if IsServer() then
        self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
        self:SyncNow("created")
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnRefresh(keys)
    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end
    if keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 then
        self.debug = true
    end

    if IsServer() then
        self:SyncNow("refresh")
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local speed = parent:GetIdealSpeed()
    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
        speed = parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
    end
    return speed
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:ComputeRate()
    local speed = self:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
        return 1
    end
    return Clamp(speed / self.base_anim_speed, 0.2, 3.0)
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:SyncNow(reason)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end

    local new_rate = self:ComputeRate()
    if math.abs((self.synced_rate or 0) - new_rate) > 0.0001 then
        self.synced_rate = new_rate
        self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
        if self.debug then
            local parent = self:GetParent()
            local eid = parent and not parent:IsNull() and parent:entindex() or -1
            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync unit=%d reason=%s rate=%.3f",
                eid, tostring(reason), new_rate))
        end
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:AddCustomTransmitterData()
    return {
        rate = self.synced_rate or 1,
    }
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
    self.synced_rate = tonumber(data.rate) or 1
    print("[Anim Rate Sync]", self.synced_rate)
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetOverrideAnimationRate()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local activity = GetRunActivity(parent)

    print("[Anim Rate]", activity)

    if activity ~= ACT_DOTA_RUN then
        return nil
    end

    print("[Anim Rate]", self.synced_rate)
    return self.synced_rate
end

local function QuatFromAxisAngle(axis, deg)
    local half = math.rad(deg) * 0.5
    local s = math.sin(half)
    return {
        w = math.cos(half),
        x = axis.x * s,
        y = axis.y * s,
        z = axis.z * s,
    }
end

local function QuatMul(a, b)
    return {
        w = a.w * b.w - a.x * b.x - a.y * b.y - a.z * b.z,
        x = a.w * b.x + a.x * b.w + a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
        y = a.w * b.y - a.x * b.z + a.y * b.w + a.z * b.x,
        z = a.w * b.z + a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x + a.z * b.w,
    }
end

local function QuatToAngles(q)
    local sinp = 2 * (q.w * q.x + q.y * q.z)
    local cosp = 1 - 2 * (q.x * q.x + q.y * q.y)
    local pitch = math.atan2(sinp, cosp)

    local siny = 2 * (q.w * q.y - q.z * q.x)
    local yaw
    if math.abs(siny) >= 1 then
        yaw = (siny >= 0) and (math.pi / 2) or (-math.pi / 2)
    else
        yaw = math.asin(siny)
    end

    local sinr = 2 * (q.w * q.z + q.x * q.y)
    local cosr = 1 - 2 * (q.y * q.y + q.z * q.z)
    local roll = math.atan2(sinr, cosr)

    return QAngle(math.deg(pitch), math.deg(yaw), math.deg(roll))
end

local function RotateVecAroundAxis(v, axis, deg)
    local rad = math.rad(deg)
    local c = math.cos(rad)
    local s = math.sin(rad)
    local ax = axis.x
    local ay = axis.y
    local az = axis.z
    local dot = v.x * ax + v.y * ay + v.z * az
    return Vector(
        v.x * c + (ay * v.z - az * v.y) * s + ax * dot * (1 - c),
        v.y * c + (az * v.x - ax * v.z) * s + ay * dot * (1 - c),
        v.z * c + (ax * v.y - ay * v.x) * s + az * dot * (1 - c)
    )
end

local function AnglesFromForwardUp(forward, up)

    local u = up:Normalized()

    local base = VectorToAngles(f)
    base.z = 0

    local roll = math.atan2(sinv, cosv)

modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate = class({})

local function Clamp(v, lo, hi)
    if v < lo then
        return lo
    end
    if v > hi then
        return hi
    end
    return v
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsHidden()
    return true
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsPurgable()
    return false
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:IsDebuff()
    return false
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE,
    }
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnCreated(keys)
    self.base_anim_speed = 300
    self.synced_rate = 1
    self.debug = keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 or false

    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end

    if IsServer() then
        self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
        self:SyncNow("created")
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:OnRefresh(keys)
    if keys and keys.base_anim_speed then
        local v = tonumber(keys.base_anim_speed)
        if v and v > 0 then
            self.base_anim_speed = v
        end
    end
    if keys and tonumber(keys.debug or 0) == 1 then
        self.debug = true
    end

    if IsServer() then
        self:SyncNow("refresh")
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local speed = parent:GetIdealSpeed()
    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
        speed = parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
    end
    return speed
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:ComputeRate()
    local speed = self:GetCurrentMoveSpeed()
    if not speed or speed <= 0 then
        return 1
    end
    return Clamp(speed / self.base_anim_speed, 0.2, 3.0)
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:SyncNow(reason)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end

    local new_rate = self:ComputeRate()
    if math.abs((self.synced_rate or 0) - new_rate) > 0.0001 then
        self.synced_rate = new_rate
        self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
        if self.debug then
            local parent = self:GetParent()
            local eid = parent and not parent:IsNull() and parent:entindex() or -1
            print(string.format("[unitanim_mod] sync unit=%d reason=%s rate=%.3f",
                eid, tostring(reason), new_rate))
        end
    end
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:AddCustomTransmitterData()
    return {
        rate = self.synced_rate or 1,
    }
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
    self.synced_rate = tonumber(data.rate) or 1
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:ShouldOverrideRate()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    if not parent:IsMoving() then
        return false
    end

    if parent:IsAttacking() then
        return false
    end

    if parent:IsChanneling() then
        return false
    end

    return true
end

function modifier_test_unitanim_move_rate:GetOverrideAnimationRate()
    if not self:ShouldOverrideRate() then
        return nil
    end

    return self.synced_rate
end

ANIMATIONS_VERSION = "1.00"

--[[
  Lua-controlled Animations Library by BMD

  Installation
  -"require" this file inside your code in order to gain access to the StartAnmiation and EndAnimation global.
  -Additionally, ensure that this file is placed in the vscripts/libraries path and that the vscripts/libraries/modifiers/modifier_animation.lua, modifier_animation_translate.lua, modifier_animation_translate_permanent.lua, and modifier_animation_freeze.lua files exist and are in the correct path

  Usage
  -Animations can be started for any unit and are provided as a table of information to the StartAnimation call
  -Repeated calls to StartAnimation for a single unit will cancel any running animation and begin the new animation
  -EndAnimation can be called in order to cancel a running animation
  -Animations are specified by a table which has as potential parameters:
    -duration: The duration to play the animation.  The animation will be cancelled regardless of how far along it is at the end fo the duration.
    -activity: An activity code which will be used as the base activity for the animation i.e. DOTA_ACT_RUN, DOTA_ACT_ATTACK, etc.
    -rate: An optional (will be 1.0 if unspecified) animation rate to be used when playing this animation.
    -translate: An optional translate activity modifier string which can be used to modify the animation sequence.
      Example: For ACT_DOTA_RUN+haste, this should be "haste"
    -translate2: A second optional translate activity modifier string which can be used to modify the animation sequence further.
      Example: For ACT_DOTA_ATTACK+sven_warcry+sven_shield, this should be "sven_warcry" or "sven_shield" while the translate property is the other translate modifier
  -A permanent activity translate can be applied to a unit by calling AddAnimationTranslate for that unit.  This allows for a permanent "injured" or "aggressive" animation stance.
  -Permanent activity translate modifiers can be removed with RemoveAnimationTranslate.
  -Animations can be frozen in place at any time by calling FreezeAnimation(unit[, duration]).  Leaving the duration off will cause the animation to be frozen until UnfreezeAnimation is called.
  -Animations can be unfrozen at any time by calling UnfreezeAnimation(unit)

  Notes
  -Animations can only play for valid activities/sequences possessed by the model the unit is using.
  -Sequences requiring 3+ activity modifier translates (i.e "stun+fear+loadout" or similar) are not possible currently in this library.
  -Calling EndAnimation and attempting to StartAnimation a new animation for the same unit withing ~2 server frames of the animation end will likely fail to play the new animation.  
    Calling StartAnimation directly without ending the previous animation will automatically add in this delay and cancel the previous animation.
  -The maximum animation rate which can be used is 12.75, and animation rates can only exist at a 0.05 resolution (i.e. 1.0, 1.05, 1.1 and not 1.06)
  -StartAnimation and EndAnimation functions can also be accessed through GameRules as GameRules.StartAnimation and GameRules.EndAnimation for use in scoped lua files (triggers, vscript ai, etc)
  -This library requires that the "libraries/timers.lua" be present in your vscripts directory.

  Examples:
  --Start a running animation at 2.5 rate for 2.5 seconds
    StartAnimation(unit, {duration=2.5, activity=ACT_DOTA_RUN, rate=2.5})

  --End a running animation
    EndAnimation(unit)

  --Start a running + hasted animation at .8 rate for 5 seconds
    StartAnimation(unit, {duration=5, activity=ACT_DOTA_RUN, rate=0.8, translate="haste"})

    StartAnimation(unit, {duration=1.5, activity=ACT_DOTA_ATTACK, rate=RandomFloat(.5, 1.5), translate="sven_warcry", translate2="sven_shield"})

  --Freeze an animation for 4 seconds

  --Unfreeze an animation

local function QuatFromAxisAngle(axis, deg)
    local half = math.rad(deg) * 0.5
    local s = math.sin(half)
    return {
        w = math.cos(half),
        x = axis.x * s,
        y = axis.y * s,
        z = axis.z * s,
    }
end

local function QuatMul(a, b)
    return {
        w = a.w * b.w - a.x * b.x - a.y * b.y - a.z * b.z,
        x = a.w * b.x + a.x * b.w + a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
        y = a.w * b.y - a.x * b.z + a.y * b.w + a.z * b.x,
        z = a.w * b.z + a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x + a.z * b.w,
    }
end

local function QuatToAngles(q)
    local sinp = 2 * (q.w * q.x + q.y * q.z)
    local cosp = 1 - 2 * (q.x * q.x + q.y * q.y)
    local pitch = math.atan2(sinp, cosp)

    local siny = 2 * (q.w * q.y - q.z * q.x)
    local yaw
    if math.abs(siny) >= 1 then
        yaw = (siny >= 0) and (math.pi / 2) or (-math.pi / 2)
    else
        yaw = math.asin(siny)
    end

    local sinr = 2 * (q.w * q.z + q.x * q.y)
    local cosr = 1 - 2 * (q.y * q.y + q.z * q.z)
    local roll = math.atan2(sinr, cosr)

    return QAngle(math.deg(pitch), math.deg(yaw), math.deg(roll))
end

local function RotateVecAroundAxis(v, axis, deg)
    local rad = math.rad(deg)
    local c = math.cos(rad)
    local s = math.sin(rad)
    local ax = axis.x
    local ay = axis.y
    local az = axis.z
    local dot = v.x * ax + v.y * ay + v.z * az
    return Vector(
        v.x * c + (ay * v.z - az * v.y) * s + ax * dot * (1 - c),
        v.y * c + (az * v.x - ax * v.z) * s + ay * dot * (1 - c),
        v.z * c + (ax * v.y - ay * v.x) * s + az * dot * (1 - c)
    )
end

local function AnglesFromForwardUp(forward, up)
    local f = forward:Normalized()
    local u = up:Normalized()

    local base = VectorToAngles(f)
    base.z = 0

    local up0 = RotatePosition(Vector(0, 0, 0), base, Vector(0, 0, 1)):Normalized()
    local u0 = (up0 - f * (up0:Dot(f))):Normalized()
    local u1 = (u - f * (u:Dot(f))):Normalized()

    local cross = u0:Cross(u1)
    local sinv = f:Dot(cross)
    local cosv = u0:Dot(u1)
    local roll = math.atan2(sinv, cosv)

    return QAngle(base.x, base.y, math.deg(roll))
end

    if not player then return end
    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()

        table.insert(args, word)
    end

    local command = args[1]
    local value = tonumber(args[2])

    -- 1. 英雄升级
    if command == "-lvl" then
        local count = value or self.Config.default_level
        if hero then
            for i = 1, count do
                hero:HeroLevelUp(true)
            end
        end

    elseif command == "-gold" then
        local amt = value or self.Config.default_gold
        if PlayerResourceExt then
            PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", amt)
        end

    elseif command == "-wood" then
        local amt = value or self.Config.default_wood
        if PlayerResourceExt then
            PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "wood", amt)
        end

        local amt = value or self.Config.default_kill

        end

        local amt = value or self.Config.default_all
        if PlayerResourceExt then
            PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", amt)
            PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "wood", amt)

function StartAnimation(unit, table)
  local duration = table.duration
  local activity = table.activity
  local translate = table.translate
  local translate2 = table.translate2
  local rate = table.rate or 1.0

  rate = math.floor(math.max(0,math.min(255/20, rate)) * 20 + .5)

  local stacks = activity + bit.lshift(rate,11)

  if translate ~= nil then
    if _ANIMATION_TRANSLATE_TO_CODE[translate] == nil then
      print("[ANIMATIONS.lua] ERROR, no translate-code found for '" .. translate .. "'.  This translate may be misspelled or need to be added to the enum manually.")

    print("[ANIMATIONS.lua] ERROR, no translate-code found for '" .. translate2 .. "'.  This translate may be misspelled or need to be added to the enum manually.")
    return
  end

    EndAnimation(unit)
    Timers:CreateTimer(.066, function() 
      if translate2 ~= nil then
        unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_animation_translate", {duration=duration, translate=translate2})
        unit:SetModifierStackCount("modifier_animation_translate", unit, _ANIMATION_TRANSLATE_TO_CODE[translate2])
      end

      unit._animationEnd = GameRules:GetGameTime() + duration
      unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_animation", {duration=duration, translate=translate})
      unit:SetModifierStackCount("modifier_animation", unit, stacks)
    end)
  else
    if translate2 ~= nil then
      unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_animation_translate", {duration=duration, translate=translate2})
      unit:SetModifierStackCount("modifier_animation_translate", unit, _ANIMATION_TRANSLATE_TO_CODE[translate2])
    end

    unit._animationEnd = GameRules:GetGameTime() + duration
    unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_animation", {duration=duration, translate=translate})
    unit:SetModifierStackCount("modifier_animation", unit, stacks)
  end
end

function FreezeAnimation(unit, duration)
  if duration then
    unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_animation_freeze", {duration=duration})
  else
    unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_animation_freeze", {})
  end
end

function UnfreezeAnimation(unit)
  unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_animation_freeze")
end

function EndAnimation(unit)
  unit._animationEnd = GameRules:GetGameTime()
  unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_animation")
  unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_animation_translate")
end

function AddAnimationTranslate(unit, translate)
  if translate == nil or _ANIMATION_TRANSLATE_TO_CODE[translate] == nil then
    print("[ANIMATIONS.lua] ERROR, no translate-code found for '" .. translate .. "'.  This translate may be misspelled or need to be added to the enum manually.")
    return
  end

  unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_animation_translate_permanent", {translate = translate})
  unit:SetModifierStackCount("modifier_animation_translate_permanent", unit, _ANIMATION_TRANSLATE_TO_CODE[translate])
end

function RemoveAnimationTranslate(unit)
  unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_animation_translate_permanent")
end

基于你当前工程代码，结论是：

1. `duration` 不能不传  
- `StartAnimation` 里直接做了 `unit._animationEnd = GameRules:GetGameTime() + duration`，`duration` 为 `nil` 会出错。  
- 见 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:449`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:480`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:490`。

2. `StartAnimation` 生效期间，后续 AI 下发其他命令不会自动切回对应动画  
- `modifier_animation` 持续返回 `MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION` 和 `MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE`，会强制覆盖。  
- 见 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_animation.lua:413`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_animation.lua:422`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_animation.lua:426`。  
- 只有到 `duration` 结束、手动 `EndAnimation(unit)`，或再次 `StartAnimation` 覆盖时才会变。`StartAnimation` 本身也会先 `EndAnimation` 旧的。见 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:472`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:473`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:508`。

如果你要“长期根据移速调跑步速率，同时不锁死 AI 其他动作”，`StartAnimation` 不是最合适方案。

基于你当前工程代码，结论是：

1. `duration` 不能不传  
- `StartAnimation` 里直接做了 `unit._animationEnd = GameRules:GetGameTime() + duration`，`duration` 为 `nil` 会出错。  
- 见 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:449`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:480`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:490`。

2. `StartAnimation` 生效期间，后续 AI 下发其他命令不会自动切回对应动画  
- `modifier_animation` 持续返回 `MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION` 和 `MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE`，会强制覆盖。  
- 见 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_animation.lua:413`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_animation.lua:422`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_animation.lua:426`。  
- 只有到 `duration` 结束、手动 `EndAnimation(unit)`，或再次 `StartAnimation` 覆盖时才会变。`StartAnimation` 本身也会先 `EndAnimation` 旧的。见 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:472`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:473`、`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/animations.lua:508`。

如果你要“长期根据移速调跑步速率，同时不锁死 AI 其他动作”，`StartAnimation` 不是最合适方案。
